description: Three-path real-runtime 2s comparison: baseline JSON, current retained legacy JSON, current new JSONL. Same canonical starting histories; JSONL fixture setup excluded and no migration invoked. All canonical, business SQL and returned display fields checked outside timers. Warm OS cache; process startup, DB startup and compilation excluded. Legacy JSON complete-return without indexing; original JSON loads once before all in-memory display pages. No IPC, renderer, file index or provenance observers.
